payload.comment: Ingestion stage is clean. PathMNIST (9-class, 3-channel, 28×28 RGB MedMNIST) loaded with split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) matching official sizes exactly; no subsampling. Archive MD5 and SHA256 verified against the Zenodo source. All nine tissue-class labels are present and consistent with the standard PathMNIST taxonomy. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K, different clinical center) is correctly recorded and will be relevant for the OOD AUROC aggregation (arithmetic mean across corruption severities). Deterministic findings list is empty; no omitted artifacts. One minor reproducibility note: llm_model_digest is null for the ollama/qwen3.8 backend, so the exact model weights cannot be independently verified. This does not affect data integrity at the ingestion stage but should be tracked for downstream stages where the LLM may influence decisions. No blocking issues; proceed to the next stage.
